Ingredients: Chickpeas, Onion, Tomato, Garlic, Ginger, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Soak chickpeas overnight and boil until tender.
Step 2: Sauté onions, garlic, and ginger in oil until golden.
Step 3: Add tomatoes and spices, cook until oil separates.
Step 4: Add boiled chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with coriander and serve hot.
Suggestion: Use less oil for an even healthier version.

Ingredients: Basmati rice, Mixed vegetables, Onion, Spices, Ghee
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Parboil rice and set aside.
Step 2: Sauté onions and vegetables with spices.
Step 3: Layer rice and vegetable mixture in a pot.
Step 4: Cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with fried onions and serve.
Suggestion: Use brown rice for added fiber and nutrients.

Ingredients: Tofu, Coconut milk, Tomato puree, Onion, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Press and cube tofu, then marinate in spices.
Step 2: Bake or pan-fry marinated tofu until crispy.
Step 3: Sauté onions and add tomato puree and spices.
Step 4: Stir in coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 5: Add crispy tofu and cook for 5 more minutes.
Step 6: Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
Suggestion: Add more vegetables for extra nutrients.

Ingredients: Lentils, Mixed vegetables, Onion, Tomato, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook lentils until soft and set aside.
Step 2: Sauté onions, add tomatoes and spices.
Step 3: Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Step 4: Stir in cooked lentils and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 5: Garnish with coriander and serve.
Suggestion: Already very healthy. Serve with brown rice for added fiber.

Ingredients: Quinoa, Mixed vegetables, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Lemon juice
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Rinse quinoa and set aside.
Step 2: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
Step 3: Add vegetables and sauté until tender.
Step 4: Add quinoa and water, cook until quinoa is fluffy.
Step 5: Squeeze lemon juice, mix well, and serve hot.
Suggestion: Add nuts or seeds for extra protein and healthy fats.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, and spices for 2 hours.
Step 2: Thread marinated chicken onto skewers.
Step 3: Grill or bake until chicken is cooked through and charred.
Step 4: Serve hot with mint chutney and lemon wedges.
Suggestion: Use skinless chicken breast for a leaner option.

Ingredients: Eggs, Onion, Tomato, Green chili, Coriander, Spices
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Beat eggs with chopped vegetables and spices.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and pour the egg mixture.
Step 3: Cook until the bottom is golden brown.
Step 4: Flip and cook the other side.
Step 5: Fold and serve hot with chutney or ketchup.
Suggestion: Use one whole egg and two egg whites for a lower-fat version.

Ingredients: Cucumber, Tomato, Onion, Lemon juice, Chaat masala
BriefInstructions: Step 1: Chop cucumber, tomato, and onion into small cubes.
Step 2: Mix vegetables in a bowl.
Step 3: Add lemon juice and chaat masala.
Step 4: Toss well and serve chilled.
Suggestion: Already very healthy. Add sprouted beans for extra protein.
